about: Every budget the Observatory's perf scripts enforce (limits, read through shared-web/perf/'s budgetLimits()) and every number its docs show (metrics, rendered by `just observatory report`). Source forms are documented at the top of shared-web/scripts/report.ts.

ttfpOverBaseline.what: `check`: the GPUI contender's reference TTFP over perf/baseline.json's, as a fraction, at each feature level (the base's at the top, each other level's under `levels`)

wasmOverBaseline.what: `check`: the GPUI contender's wasm (brotli) over the baseline's, as a fraction, at each feature level

firstPaintJsOverBaseline.what: `check`: the TanStack contender's first-paint JS (the entry and its static imports, brotli) over perf/baseline.json's, as a fraction, at each feature level (the base's at the top, each other level's under `levels`)

dataLayerJsOverBaseline.what: `check`: the TanStack contender's after-paint data layer with Arrow (brotli) over perf/baseline.json's, as a fraction, at each feature level

firstPaintOverBaseline.what: `check`: the page's reference first paint (paint timing's `first-paint`, at Big file's route, /observatory/tall-table/big-file/) over perf/baseline.json's, as a fraction

firstPaintJsOverBaseline.what: `check`: the page's first-paint JS (the scripts its routes load and their static imports, brotli) over perf/baseline.json's, as a fraction
